$description: Motion. Expressive tier everywhere except the menu family (menu, popover, tooltip), which is Confident because those open dozens of times an hour. Guardrails in $extensions apply at every tier.

4.$description: tab pill, drawer, sidebar collapse, list stagger base

5.$description: modal, toast, row removal — anything that travels

spring.$description: arrival with overshoot — the Expressive tier

linear.$description: progress and spinners only, never a transform

modal-enter.$description: Expressive — rises and settles with overshoot

menu-enter.$description: Confident — opened constantly, so no overshoot and no item stagger

tooltip-enter.$description: fastest of the family — appears on hover

toast-enter.$description: Expressive — it arrives unasked, so it should be felt

tab-glide.$description: Expressive — the pill travels between tabs

list-enter.$description: Expressive — first paint only, 80ms stagger, never on a poll

row-exit.$description: Expressive — a dismissed row leaves so the list does not blink

d3.never-animate: a table row whose content changed on a poll — Bindery and App A both repoll
route changes inside a data view
text reflow, column widths, table layout — columns drop at a breakpoint, they do not slide
the focus ring — it must appear on the same frame as the keypress
$extensions.d3.fill-mode: Entrances animate FROM an offset TO the natural state with animation-fill-mode: backwards, never forwards. A retained transform makes the wrapper a containing block and silently breaks every position:fixed overlay inside it.
